request: Analyze GSE280324 for PMID 39730655 (Effects of moderate intensity exercise on liver metabolism in mice based on multi-omics analysis.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of mouse liver (BGISEQ-500), plus proteomics/lactylome (PXD057080) and metabolomics (MTBLS11477) not analysed here
final.sample_inclusion: adult male C57BL/6J mice, liver; transcriptomics n=3 per group (S2.1.p1)
final.primary_estimand: effect of 6 weeks of moderate-intensity treadmill exercise vs sedentary control on liver gene expression, sampled within 24 h after the last bout (S2.1.p1)
planned_contrasts: Experimental (EX) vs Control (SED), liver (S8.1.p1; paper: 2034 DEGs, 1456 up / 578 down)
final.paper_method: limma v3.46.0 on log2(TPM+1), ~ group (S3.p1, S7.1.p1, TAB1)

paper_threshold.note: paper: raw p < 0.05 & (FC > 1.2 or FC < 0.83); the down cutoff 0.83 is log2 = -0.2688167, slightly stricter than 1/1.2

final.paper_results: 2034 DEGs (1456 up, 578 down); 82 intersection genes with Hallmark hypoxia/glycolysis/fatty-acid sets; hub genes Aldoa, Acsl1, Hadhb up in EX at mRNA level (S8.1.p1, S8.3.p1); Fasn up (S9.p3)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Single two-group transcriptomics comparison: S2.1.p1 (design, n=3/group), S3.p1 (TPM, log2(x+1), limma, p<0.05 & FC 1.2/0.83), S8.1.p1 (2034 DEGs). Other omics are outside GSE280324.

checks: DA.p1 names GSE280324 as the transcriptomics deposit
GEO: Mus musculus liver, 6 samples, 3 Con + 3 treadmill-running, matching n=3 per group in S2.1.p1
contact Ting Zhang, Beijing Municipal Key Laboratory of Child Development and Nutriomics (Capital Institute of Pediatrics; TZ is an author)

ownership.reasoning: Paper data-availability statement and GEO sample structure agree.

alignment.reasoning: GEO 'description' holds fpkm_<tag> (e.g. fpkm_C_48); prep_tpm.py renamed the tpm_<tag> matrix columns to <tag>, so the key is the tag. Group letter C/E in the tag agrees with title (Er C1..C3 vs E1..E3) and characteristics treatment (Con mice did not use treadmill vs running 22 km).

matrix.reasoning: Prepared from the tpm_* block of GSE280324_FPKM.txt.gz: non-integer, each column sums to 1e6 (true TPM). The deposited file also has FPKM, non-integer read_count and group-average columns, which were dropped. Paper input is TPM -> log2(TPM+1) (S3.p1), so this matches the paper.

design.reasoning: One factor, two levels, independent mice (S2.1.p1). n=3 per group is small but is the paper's design; contrast run as planned.

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals randomized to groups (S2.1.p1); no batch, sex (all male) or pairing recorded in GEO.

deviations: inmoose limma port instead of R limma 3.46.0; no expression filter stated in the paper, none applied

method.reasoning: S3.p1: TPM log2(x+1) then limma. TPM is supported by limma after log transform.

final.deviation_note: Paper rule is raw p < 0.05 & (FC > 1.2 or FC < 0.83). The runner applies a symmetric |log2FC| > log2(1.2) = 0.2630344; the exact asymmetric down cutoff log2(0.83) = -0.2688167 is recomputed post hoc in HANDBACK.md. Audit rule BH padj < 0.05 reported separately.

threshold.reasoning: S3.p1 and TAB1 state raw p < 0.05 and FC > 1.2 or < 0.83.

caveats: raw p threshold (paper's) is permissive; BH audit count reported
down FC cutoff asymmetry handled post hoc

study.reasoning: S8.1.p1: 2034 DEGs (1456 up, 578 down); S8.3.p1: Aldoa, Acsl1, Hadhb mRNA up in EX; S9.p3: Fasn mRNA up.

discrepancies.data: GSE280324_FPKM.txt.gz holds FPKM, TPM and read_count blocks; TPM block used

enrichment.reasoning: paper uses Hallmark hypoxia/glycolysis/fatty-acid sets and GO/KEGG enrichment (S3.p1, S8.1.p1)
